name: mcp-servers
description: Loup's MCP tool servers: self-hosted ones reached over the internet at https://mcp.loup-peluso.com behind Cloudflare Access (one tunnel, path-routed) — Google Workspace for three accounts (perso, work, cassandra), Slack, Google Maps, and WhatsApp (wacli) — plus Exa web search via its hosted remote MCP. Supply the Cloudflare Access service-token credentials for the self-hosted hostname, and an Exa API key for Exa, to enable.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: The CF-Access-Client-Id for the mcp.loup-peluso.com Access service token (public identifier, ends in .access). Sent as a request header so Cloudflare Access lets the request through at the edge.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The CF-Access-Client-Secret paired with the Client ID. Stored locally in settings.json (personal connector); maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in mcp-secrets.sops.json.

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API Key
EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa web search (https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys), sent as the x-api-key header to the hosted MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. Stored locally in settings.json; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in mcp-secrets.sops.json.
